title: 50 Korean Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Korean for Beginners (Self Improvement)
description:
Learn 50 essential Korean phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Korean #LearnKorean #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in 한국어, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Korean with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 50 real-life phrases
- 한국어 audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

CHAPTERS
0:07  Self Improvement · 자기계발
1:28  Doctor & Pharmacy · 의사 및 약국
2:45  Happiness · 행복
4:01  Dating & Romance · 데이트 및 연애
5:12  Meeting People & Greetings · 사람 만나기 및 인사
6:38  Common Native Slang · 자주 쓰이는 원어민 은어
7:56  Feelings & Emotions · 감정 및 느낌
9:20  Gratitude · 감사

PHRASE LIST

SELF IMPROVEMENT · 자기계발
• Turn stress into quiet focus - 스트레스를 조용한 집중으로 바꿔요.  [Seu-teu-re-seu-reul JOYONG-HAN JIP-JUNG-eu-ro BAKKWO-yo.]
• Write it down, then do it - 적어두고, 바로 해봐요.  [JIK-eo-du-go, BA-RO HAE-BWA-yo.]
• Do the hard thing first - 어려운 일을 먼저 해요.  [EO- RYO-UN IL-IL MEON-JEO HAE-yo.]
• Practice, then review your mistakes - 연습하고, 실수는 다시 보며 고쳐요.  [YEON-SUP-ha-go, SIL-SU-neun DA-SI BOM-myeo GO-CHEO-yo.]
• Clean your desk, clear your mind - 책상 정리하면 마음도 정리돼요.  [CHAEK-SANG JUNG-RI-ha-myeon MA-UM-do JUNG-ri-DWE-yo.]
• One call, one message, no fear - 한 통화, 한 메시지로 겁을 줄여요.  [HAN TONG-HWA, HAN MES-SI-JI-ro GOB-eul JU-lyeo-yo.]

DOCTOR & PHARMACY · 의사 및 약국
• I need to see a doctor today. - 오늘 진료받고 싶어요, 의사 선생님.  [o-neul JIN-nyo 받-go si-peo-yo, UI-sa seon-saeng-nim]
• Do I need an appointment? - 예약 꼭 해야 해요, 아니면 그냥 가도 돼요?  [ye-yak kkok hae-ya hae-yo, a-ni-myeon geu-nyang ga-do dwae-yo]
• Is this clinic open right now? - 지금 여기 문 열었어요?  [ji-geum yeo-gi mun yeol-eo-sseo-yo]
• I have a prescription, please. - 처방전 있어요, 약 좀 부탁드려요.  [cheo-bang-jeon i-sseo-yo, yak jom bu-tak-deu-ryeo-yo]
• Where is the pharmacy counter? - 약국 카운터가 어디예요?  [yak-guk KA-un-teo-ga eo-di-ye-yo]
• Can I pay by card here? - 여기서 카드로 결제돼요?  [yeo-gi-seo KA-deu-ro gyeol-je dwae-yo]

HAPPINESS · 행복
• Tell your heart, it will be okay - 마음에게 말해요, 괜찮아질 거라고  [Ma-eum-ege malhaeyo, gwaenchanhajil georago]
• Let gratitude lead your day - 감사가 하루를 이끌게 해요  [Gamsa-ga harueul ikk-eolge haeyo]
• Choose wonder over worry, today - 오늘은 걱정보다 경이로움을 골라요  [Oneul-eun geokjeongboda gyeong-iromeul gol-ayo]
• Make time for what feels good - 기분 좋게 하는 일에 시간을 써요  [Gibun jotge haneun ire sigan-eul sseoyo]
• Call someone just to check in - 그냥 안부 전화 한 통 해요  [Geunyang anbu jeonhwa han tong haeyo]
• Wash your day off, slowly - 하루를 천천히 씻어내요  [Haru-reul cheoncheonhi sseos-eonaeyo]

DATING & ROMANCE · 데이트 및 연애
• Want to grab coffee after work? - 퇴근하고 커피 마실래요?  [TWE-geun-ha-go KEO-pi ma-sil-lae-yo]
• Let’s meet by the theater entrance. - 극장 입구에서 만날까요?  [geuk-jang IP-gu-e-seo man-nal-kka-yo]
• I like your vibe, honestly. - 솔직히 당신 분위기 좋아요.  [SOL-jik-hi dang-sin PUN-wi-gi jo-a-yo]
• Can I hold your hand? - 손 잡아도 돼요?  [son JA-ba-do dwae-yo]
• You make me feel safe. - 당신 옆에 있으면 마음이 편해져요.  [dang-sin yeop-e IS-seu-myeon ma-eum-i pyeon-hae-jyeo-yo]
• Should we try that new ramen place? - 저기 새 라멘 집 가볼까요?  [jeo-gi sae ra-men jip ga-bol-kka-yo]

MEETING PEOPLE & GREETINGS · 사람 만나기 및 인사
• Hi, how’s it going today? - 안녕하세요, 오늘은 어떻게 지내세요?  [an-nyeong-ha-se-yo, o-neul-eun eo-tteoh-ge ji-nae-se-yo?]
• Nice to meet you, really. - 만나서 반가워요, 정말이네요.  [man-na-seo ban-ga-wo-yo, jeong-mal-i-ne-yo.]
• Are you new around here? - 여기 처음 오셨어요?  [yeo-gi cheo-um o-syeo-sseo-yo?]
• What’s your name, by the way? - 이름이 어떻게 되세요, 그건요?  [i-reum-i eo-tteo-ke dwe-seo-yo, geu-geon-yo?]
• I’m Alex, nice to meet you. - 저는 알렉스예요, 만나서 반가워요.  [jeo-neun al-leg-seu-ye-yo, man-na-seo ban-ga-wo-yo.]
• Where are you from originally? - 원래 어디에서 오셨어요?  [won-lae eo-di-e-seo o-syeo-sseo-yo?]
• Do you have a minute to chat? - 잠깐 얘기할 수 있어요?  [jam- kkan yae-gi-hal su i-sseo-yo?]

COMMON NATIVE SLANG · 자주 쓰이는 원어민 은어
• I’m gonna dip, bye for now. - 나 잠깐 빠질게, 나중에 봐.  [na jamkkan ppajilge, najunge bwae.]
• I’m so done with this. - 나 이거 완전 질렸어.  [na igeo wanjeon jirilreosseo.]
• Hold on, I’ll check that. - 잠깐만, 내가 확인해볼게.  [jamkkanman, naega hwaginhae bolge.]
• Just wing it, it’ll be fine. - 대충 해도 괜찮아, 그냥 가보자.  [daechung haedo gwaenchana, geunyang gaboja.]
• That’s cap, no way. - 그거 거짓말이야, 말도 안 돼.  [geugeo geojitmal iya, maldo an dwae.]
• You’re overreacting, chill. - 너 너무 과해, 진정해.  [neo neomu gwahae, jinjonghae.]

FEELINGS & EMOTIONS · 감정 및 느낌
• I feel a little nervous, honestly - 나 좀 긴장되는 것 같아, 솔직히  [na Jom GIN-jang-doeneun geot gata, SOL-jik-hi]
• Right now, I'm overwhelmed - 지금 너무 벅차요  [ji-geum NEO-mu BEOK-cha-yo]
• I'm so relieved it worked - 되게 잘돼서 안심돼요  [doe-ge CHAL-dwae-seo an-SIM-dwae-yo]
• I feel lonely when I’m quiet - 조용해지면 외로워요  [jo-yong-hae-ji-myeon oe-RO-wo-yo]
• I'm excited for tonight - 오늘밤 너무 기대돼요  [o-neul-bam NEO-mu GIDAE-dwae-yo]
